# LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, and FULL JOIN

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, and FULL JOIN

A FULL JOIN combines the results of both a LEFT JOIN and a RIGHT JOIN. Take a look at the image below.

![LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN and FULL JOIN](data:image/png;base64,)

You can see FULL JOIN returns all rows from both the LEFT JOIN and RIGHT JOIN tables, whether there is a match in the other table or not.
